clusters.title: Optimize Resource Usage and Performance
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing excessive token consumption, memory leaks, infinite loops, and performance regressions that waste computational resources and increase costs. They want the system to be more efficient with tokens, memory, and processing during agent operations, particularly during extended thinking, waiting states, and tool execution. These issues cause degraded performance and unexpected resource exhaustion.
clusters.representative_need: Fix excessive token consumption from inefficient agent behavior that wastes context on elaborate steps without progressing
sample_titles: Fix excessive token consumption from inefficient agent behavior that wastes context on elaborate steps without progressing
Fix memory leak or infinite loop causing heap exhaustion during context processing
Fix performance regression in tool calls

clusters.title: CLI Reliability and UX Bug Fixes
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing multiple reliability issues with the CLI tool including hanging on 'thinking' states, incorrect output display in non-interactive contexts, authentication dialog handling problems, and inconsistent keyboard shortcuts across platforms. These fixes address session management, input handling, and display rendering to improve overall CLI stability.
clusters.representative_need: Add SSH session detection helper function
sample_titles: Add SSH session detection helper function
Clear authentication dialog from terminal before CLI process exits
Fix CLI getting stuck in 'thinking' state and not responding

clusters.title: Google AI Pro authentication and quota fixes
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing authentication failures, incorrect error messages, and quota visibility issues when using Google AI Pro accounts. Issues include 403 PERMISSION_DENIED errors after successful OAuth, race conditions in the OIDC login flow, and inability to distinguish between personal vs workspace accounts. Developers need reliable account type detection, clearer error messaging, and proper quota handling to effectively use the CLI.
clusters.representative_need: Detect account type and display contextually appropriate error messages for personal accounts instead of workspace-themed errors
sample_titles: Detect account type and display contextually appropriate error messages for personal accounts instead of workspace-themed errors
Fix 403 PERMISSION_DENIED errors for Google AI Pro accounts that successfully authenticate but cannot use the CLI
Fix Pro subscription quota entitlement recognition and sync for OAuth authenticated users receiving 429 errors

clusters.title: Graceful rate limit error handling
clusters.summary: Users encountering HTTP 429 rate limit errors need the application to handle them gracefully, either through automatic retry logic with backoff or by providing clear, actionable error messages that explain why requests were blocked and when users can retry. This improves the developer experience and reduces frustration when hitting API limits.
clusters.representative_need: Handle 429 rate limit errors gracefully with clear messaging and retry guidance
sample_titles: Handle 429 rate limit errors gracefully with clear messaging and retry guidance
Handle rate limit (429) errors gracefully with retry logic or clearer user messaging

clusters.title: Bug Fixes and Quality Improvements
clusters.summary: Users are reporting various bugs affecting core functionality, UI correctness, and data integrity. These include crashes when handling specific characters, infinite loops during MCP server connections, session persistence failures, and UI rendering issues in tables and sidebars. Addressing these issues will improve overall application stability and user experience.
clusters.representative_need: Add an internal TelemetryProvider interface abstraction for extensible telemetry backends
sample_titles: Add an internal TelemetryProvider interface abstraction for extensible telemetry backends
Add support for gender-neutral or inclusive terminology when describing hierarchical technical concepts
Apply .geminignore patterns to grep and ripgrep commands to prevent scanning of sensitive directories

clusters.title: Agent Reliability and Stability Fixes
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing multiple reliability issues with the agent, including unresponsiveness after updates, endless thinking loops, unhandled crashes during file operations, and failure to properly execute halt commands. These stability problems significantly impact workflow continuity and user trust in the agent's ability to complete tasks reliably.
clusters.representative_need: Add 'Other' option to yesno question type to enable custom feedback responses
sample_titles: Add 'Other' option to yesno question type to enable custom feedback responses
Fix agent becoming unresponsive after version update to Gemini 3.1
Fix agent to properly respect and execute halt commands when conditions are met

clusters.title: Fix editor bugs causing crashes and corruption
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing multiple critical bugs in the editor and file handling systems that cause unexpected behavior, crashes, and data corruption. These issues range from minor UX problems like scroll reset when viewing diffs to serious issues like file content corruption on Windows. Fixing these bugs is essential for maintaining user trust and preventing data loss.
clusters.representative_need: Fix automatic scroll reset when viewing diffs in the editor
sample_titles: Fix automatic scroll reset when viewing diffs in the editor
Fix external editor integration crash when typing in the external editor
Fix replace tool corrupting files on Windows by blanking entire file content instead of applying the intended diff changes

clusters.title: Fix and enhance gemini extensions functionality
clusters.summary: These issues relate to improving the gemini extensions system by fixing directory resolution bugs, enabling third-party extension submissions, and resolving missing files in the NPM bundle. Users need a reliable and extensible system for managing role-based SDLC skills through the CLI.
clusters.representative_need: Fix extension plan directory resolution to use the correct extension-specific or default directory based on active extension state
sample_titles: Fix extension plan directory resolution to use the correct extension-specific or default directory based on active extension state
Fix missing examples directory in NPM bundle causing gemini extensions new command to fail
Support third-party extension submissions for role-based SDLC skills

clusters.title: Configuration Settings and Defaults
clusters.summary: Users want settings to work as intended and have better default behaviors. One issue is that the 'inlineThinkingMode' setting is being ignored, causing unwanted thinking tokens to appear. Another request is to change the default value of 'Compact Tool Output' to be enabled by default, improving the user experience out of the box.
clusters.representative_need: Enable 'Compact Tool Output' setting by default
sample_titles: Enable 'Compact Tool Output' setting by default
Fix thinking tokens appearing when inlineThinkingMode is configured to off

clusters.title: Improve UI Information Display and Readability
clusters.summary: Users want improvements to the interface including fixing missing information displays (like email and tier), adding persistent navigation elements (sticky header), and improving output readability with concise summaries. These enhancements would make the application more intuitive and reduce visual clutter while maintaining access to important context.
clusters.representative_need: Fix missing email and tier information in UI when options are enabled
sample_titles: Fix missing email and tier information in UI when options are enabled
Implement persistent sticky topic header at top of application layout
Improve tool output formatting and readability by providing more concise summaries for large or repetitive outputs
